overview: The Altar of Ssraeshza is the sacred ritual chamber of the Shissar.
details: Here, serpent priests perform venom rites, bind undead guardians, and channel cursed magic. The altar pulses with divine energy, and the High Priest enforces Ssraeshza’s will.
hooks: A venom rite destabilizes, releasing cursed energy.
Undead Shissar awaken from ritual slumber.
A serpent priest attempts a forbidden summoning.
The High Priest calls down Ssraeshza’s divine wrath.
